title: Cheesy Casserole
description: A simple, comforting casserole made with melted cheddar cheese and a crispy top.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine shredded cheese and crushed crackers.
Add sliced american cheese and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish.
Top with sliced casserole and additional shredded cheese.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with crushed crackers.
Return to oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
